task.title: P6-087: Decide whether a rail section should spring open on an incoming query-bar filter
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 6 — Decisions the maintainer owns). Original id: P6-087. Size: S, decision first. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**Should a rail section spring open when a filter arrives from the query bar?** `<details>` openness is seeded once and deliberately non-reactive (so a re-derive cannot slam a section shut mid-click; the doc comment states the tradeoff), which means typing `r:rare` shows only the collapsed Rarity summary badge.
